## Summary

Describe the change and identify the affected layer: framework, implementation or demonstration.

## Verification

- [ ] Repository checks pass.
- [ ] Notebook outputs/execution counts are cleared.
- [ ] No credentials or restricted data are included.
- [ ] Links, attribution and licence notices are preserved.
- [ ] Scientific changes include reproducible evidence and explicit units/time conventions.

## Scientific or publication implications

State whether results, mappings, dependencies or article availability statements change. Do not describe packaging checks as scientific validation.
